title: The Phantom Ship
author: Frederick Marryat
description: "The Phantom Ship" by Frederick Marryat is a Gothic novel published in 1839 that explores the legend of the Flying Dutchman.
longDescription: Philip Vanderdecken embarks on a perilous quest to save his father's cursed spirit, doomed to sail eternally after making a rash oath.

authorInfo.bio: Frederick Marryat (1792–1848) wrote The Children of the New Forest. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
